daily_scan.notes: Breadth-first single-alias pass across all 9 due records (adocia-adoxlong, ascendis-transcon-novo, ascletis-asc30, astrazeneca-zoladex, cspc-syh2082, lilly-eloralintide, owlbio-kyungdong-xtina, samsung-bioepis-g2gbio-gb7001, zealand-petrelintide); the other 36 were checked within the last 1-2 days and are quiet 21+ days, so correctly throttled. 8 of the 9 due records reconfirmed existing findings with no material new information this run. cspc-syh2082 turned up genuine late-discovered news: an FDA clinical-trial clearance (2026-02-16, wire-corroborated) and a clinicaltrials.gov Phase I dose-escalation study (NCT07736404) with an actual dosing start of 2026-04-13 and status Active, not recruiting -- both logged as new findings and stage_label advanced Preclinical -> Phase 1 (both discovered ~5-7 months after the fact, well outside the freshness window, so treated as discovered-late rather than headline). B3 cheap pass (2/2 searches spent): re-checked cand-2026-09-17-001 (Samik Pharmaceutical) -- found only the same patent registration with a more precise date (Aug 27, 2026), not a new dated event, remains pending/near_bar; re-checked cand-2026-09-13-001 (Prolynx) -- still no IND/trial registration since the Dec 2025 Series A, remains pending/near_bar. Stall rule checked across all 16 unresolved candidates -- oldest is 16 days old, none 30+ days, none triggered. No new EGRESS_BLOCKED domains this run (no direct WebFetch attempted; all sources reached via search). clinicaltrials.gov and patents.google.com both reached via search again this run (e.g. NCT07736404, NCT07484204).
